neighbours.label: ' in' taking the complement of a preceding verb or adjective (pales in comparison, confident in, relaxed in)
fire: Last year's flood pales in scale next to this one.
Our team was quite successful in reaching new customers.
Many voters remain interested in local elections.
The old bridge differs in design from the new one.
He was always very patient in explaining the rules.
The two samples vary in colour and texture.
She is fluent in three languages, including Arabic.
That decision may result in higher prices.
quiet: Last year's flood was a disaster for the people in the valley.
Our team found new customers in the north of the country.
Many voters live in towns without a local paper.
The old bridge stands in the centre of the city.
He kept the rules in a folder on his desk.
The two samples were stored in a cold room.
She has friends in three countries, including Egypt.
There is little money in farming these days.

notes: card: ' in' x31 after pales/confident/fly/relaxed. The - pole is ' in' after a noun (strength in numbers, roots in, money in). Probe: pales in 0.78, confident in 0.61, flies in the face 0.19, strength in numbers 0.00, locative 'in the drawer' 0.04.
